title: Test-first: Slugify text
goal: Test-first: Make slugify(text, options) in src/slugify.js correct and add comprehensive tests.

steps.title: Write the tests for slugify
steps.detail: Write the tests only, in test/slugify.test.js, and change nothing else: do not write or edit src/slugify.js. That file is only a stub that throws 'not implemented', so every test is expected to FAIL now. The tests must still run, so they must import the exports named below from the stub, under the same names. Write one test for each rule and assert every example. src/slugify.js exports slugify(text, options). Rules: (1) Convert text to lowercase; (2) Replace accented Latin letters by their ASCII base letter (é becomes e, è becomes e, ê becomes e, ü becomes u, ö becomes o, ñ becomes n, ç becomes c, å becomes a, ï becomes i); (3) The character & becomes the word 'and' surrounded by separators; (4) Every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes one hyphen; (5) Remove leading and trailing hyphens; (6) options.maxLength (a positive integer, default no limit): cut the result to at most that many characters, then remove a trailing hyphen the cut left; (7) A non-string input returns the empty string. Examples: 'Hello, World!' becomes 'hello-world'; '  Crème Brûlée & Café  ' becomes 'creme-brulee-and-cafe'; 'a---b' becomes 'a-b'; 'Ünïcödé' becomes 'unicode'; ('Hello World', {maxLength: 7}) becomes 'hello-w'; ('Hello World', {maxLength: 6}) becomes 'hello'; null becomes ''; 123 becomes ''; '!!!' becomes ''; 'Rock & Roll' becomes 'rock-and-roll'. Export with module.exports = { slugify } (CommonJS). Put every test in test/slugify.test.js (node:test) and nowhere else.

steps.title: Implement slugify function
steps.detail: src/slugify.js exports slugify(text, options). Rules: (1) Convert text to lowercase; (2) Replace accented Latin letters by their ASCII base letter (é becomes e, è becomes e, ê becomes e, ü becomes u, ö becomes o, ñ becomes n, ç becomes c, å becomes a, ï becomes i); (3) The character & becomes the word 'and' surrounded by separators; (4) Every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes one hyphen; (5) Remove leading and trailing hyphens; (6) options.maxLength (a positive integer, default no limit): cut the result to at most that many characters, then remove a trailing hyphen the cut left; (7) A non-string input returns the empty string. Examples: 'Hello, World!' becomes 'hello-world'; '  Crème Brûlée & Café  ' becomes 'creme-brulee-and-cafe'; 'a---b' becomes 'a-b'; 'Ünïcödé' becomes 'unicode'; ('Hello World', {maxLength: 7}) becomes 'hello-w'; ('Hello World', {maxLength: 6}) becomes 'hello'; null becomes ''; 123 becomes ''; '!!!' becomes ''; 'Rock & Roll' becomes 'rock-and-roll'. Export with module.exports = { slugify } (CommonJS). Make the tests from the previous step pass. Do not change test/slugify.test.js: the tests are fixed, so the code must follow them.

steps.title: Run the whole test suite
steps.detail: Run npm test. Change nothing unless it fails; fix only failures that this plan's change caused.
